plan.summary: Fix concurrent add() race condition using file locking (fcntl.flock) to protect load-compute-save sequences

red_stage.description: Added 4 new tests (3 initially failing) that verify concurrent operations preserve data integrity

implementation: 2. Added _lock_path property and locked() context manager to TodoStorage
3. Wrapped add(), mark_done(), mark_undone(), remove() in cli.py with storage.locked()
green_stage.minimal_fix: Added file-based advisory locking using fcntl.flock to protect read-modify-write sequences

commands_run: uv run ruff check src/flywheel/storage.py src/flywheel/cli.py tests/test_issue_5516_concurrent_add_locking.py

risks: File locking is advisory, so processes not using the locked() context manager could still cause race conditions
Lock file (.todo.json.lock) may be left behind if process crashes during lock acquisition
fcntl is Unix-only; Windows would need a different locking mechanism
